item.title: Point Hope Releases Research on AI Adoption and the Durability of Incumbent Businesses
item.description: SINGAPORE / KUALA LUMPUR, MALAYSIA - Media OutReach Newswire - 11 February 2026 - Point Hope, a local investment firm, has published a new research note examining the implications of accelerating artificial intelligence (AI) investment, infrastructure constraints, and evolving competitive dynamics within equities markets.

item.title: De Beers Group and Assouline Celebrate the Launch of “A Diamond Is Forever: The Making of A Cultural Icon 1926-2026”

item.title: Canada PM cancels Munich trip after deadly school shooting
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney suspends his European diplomatic trip following a mass shooting in British Columbia that left nine dead.

item.title: TechStore secures RM54.8m contract from Home Affairs ministry
item.description: The 60-month project involves upgrading the records system for the National Registration Department in Putrajaya and is expected to contribute positively to the group’s earnings.

item.title: Israel president urges US action to counter Iran’s ’empire of evil’
item.description: Israel's president hopes US-Israel talks will undermine Iran's "empire of evil" as Netanyahu meets Trump to push for a harder line on Tehran.

item.title: Netanyahu to urge Trump on Iran missiles in White House talks
